blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan – The Office of the Ombudsman has ordered the dismissal of Urdaneta City Mayor Julio “Rammy” Fernandez Parayno III, Vice Mayor Jimmy Dereje Parayno, and six members of the Sangguniang Panglungsod based on consolidated administrative complaints. In its April 15, 2026 decision, the Ombudsman found the mayor and vice mayor administratively liable for grave misconduct, while the six city councilors were found liable for gross neglect of duty. Urdaneta City officials only received the Ombudsman decision on Thursday. The consolidated decision involved separate complaints filed on Jan. 22, 2025, March 17, 2025, April 28, 2025, and July 7, 2025, […]...
